profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Guidewire Software

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Participated in full SDLC development for various web services projects within the OPMS team.  Met development deadlines, performed end to end unit testing and participated in demos at the end of each sprint, all project work has been successfully moved into production.
Technical Skills Used:  J2EE, WebServices, JUnit, Eclipse, Clearcase, SOAP UI, Apache Geronimo, Agile methodology
•	DE-PI (OPMS) Project - Responsible for implementation of the Recoup Webservice API, which allowed eBay to be able to recover money back from seller.  This API was called by RRP and included logic for calling various web services in Escrow Ledger and mapping errors and responses in order to return appropriate response back to RRP. 
•	CS Get Interface Project – Responsible for implementation of the OPMS RemoveDisbursementMethod API.  This API was called by CS and included logic for calling OPMS DB to inactivate the disbursement instrument for the Seller to prevent future payouts being made to the payout method.
•	OPMS-NR Project – Enhanced consumer calls to allow for either secure or non-secure pool call as well as addition of ramp up/throttling logic.  This was a highly critical project with senior management visibility. 
•	PI (Payment Intermediation) Phase2 Project – Involved ramping up all the existing users in DE/AT site to be Payment Intermediated; once the user was PI enabled, all the transactions for that particular user would be intermediated by eBay.
•	SellerDailyRun PayoutDate Project – Responsible for implementation of changes in PPX system PD for C2C (Customer to Customer) seller to have payout date for EFT payment on a daily basis excluding Sat and Sun.  Earlier the payout date was calculated to be 4 or 5 days apart.  Purpose was to optimize the process to ensure seller receives payment sooner.
•Elvis Project – The Elvis system is an eBay internally developed api used to check fraud. Responsible for implementation of enhancements of this API for the Long Term Refund Project

positions.title: Software Engineer/Production Support
positions.description:
•	Participated in full SDLC development for the DOTS (Disputes Online Tracking System) application in the Fraud/Risk area.  DOTS was a web-based J2EE application that connected to an Oracle database and used Weblogic to communicate with TSYS (Total Systems) with XML messaging through iStream service.  Application also included Java batch processes which connected to an Oracle database and ran through Tivoli scheduler on a UNIX Solaris OS.  
•	I have had experience with Agile methodology in both my Production Support roles while at Accenture/WAMU (daily standups between offshore & onshore in which we discussed status of old and new tasks)
Technical Skills Used:
•	J2EE, XML, JUnit, Weblogic, SOAP, Oracle SQL & PL/SQL, Eclipse, Ant - Responsible for development and maintenance of DOTS application (frontend and backend components).  Development tasks for various projects, researched and resolved production defects and maintenance requests.  Developed test plans and test plan detailed criteria.
•	Visio – Design - Responsible for creating design documents and flowcharts for new projects.
•	UNIX, sftp/ftp - Developed UNIX shell scripts for various DOTS projects.
•	Production Support Risk – Ensured 80% resolution of Risk tickets at level 2.  Coordinated offshore production support Risk vertical level 2 support which included 50+ applications from the Risk area – Risk applications included mainly Java applications, both frontend and backend.  Other tasks included attending outage calls and troubleshooting and following each issue to closure as quickly as possible to ensure high availability and that SLAs were met.
Technical Skills Used:
•	Java/Oracle – Automation - Developed automated reports for CBA vertical to eliminate daily manual SQL queries as part of long term solution to reduce 15% of daily maintenance costs.
•	UNIX/shell scripts - Utilized UNIX commands/developed shell scripts to check resources used on the server, to check which processes were running on the server

educations.schoolName: Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology - SMU
